items.title: $16B OpenAI-Oracle Data Center Breaks Ground in Saline Township
items.dek: The 1.4-GW campus on 250 acres will add 2,500 union construction jobs and 450 permanent roles while pulling power from existing DTE resources plus project-funded batteries and using less water than an office building.
